note: Commercially he is the closest thing in this batch to the stated ICP: multiple businesses, works internationally, purchasing property in Hawaii, no intention of retiring, and explicitly good-to-great — 'I'm just looking to be in the best shape I can be for who I am right now.' At 179 lb, down from 228, training daily for thirteen years and eating to a deliberate macro split, he clears the deconditioned exclusion by a wide margin. He misses on neglected_health for the opposite reason to most: his health is the least neglected thing about him, which is precisely why he had no urgency and said so — 'I've got no real answer to that.' Two things the ICP does not capture and should: he is 71, well outside the age profile the criteria implicitly assume, and despite the income match he deferred a $1,000 decision on financial grounds, so 'makes good money' again failed to predict willingness to pay.
